annotations.title: Disconnect Yandex Webmaster from a project

description: Unlink a project's Yandex Webmaster host. Breaks Yandex Webmaster data for every member of the organization, not just the caller — requires at least the admin role.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: disconnect_yandex
